authorReview.scope: Complete eight-sentence script checked against canonical short-reader opening evidence for premise, clear identity, specific interest and protected revelations.
authorReview.targetDuration: About one minute at an unhurried conversational pace with real pauses; measure after recording.
authorReview.emotion: Concrete recognition, thoughtful tension and open curiosity; no melodramatic mystery or inflated promise.
authorReview.audioConversion: Blocked until all batch scripts pass independent editorial review.
authorReview.visualExecution: The existing art is preserved as working material; book-specific changes above still require implementation before film validation.

notes: Removed inspectable, executable-companion and accountable-reasoning abstractions. Explained the proposed links through study code, data, assumptions and revised conclusions. Kept the need for interpretation.
Every spoken sentence independently checked against the canonical English source for clear purpose, intended viewer response, source fidelity and natural spoken wording.
All scenes remain compact, with one sentence per clip and specific restrained delivery directions. Viewer responses are editorial intentions, not results from audience testing.

sentenceIntentions.text: You run a study’s code and get the same result, but does its conclusion follow?
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Distinguish repeated computation from justified interpretation.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize a clear gap in what rerunning code establishes.

sentenceIntentions.text: Executable Scientific Intelligence proposes scientific papers whose claims can be checked through linked data and code.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Introduce the source-specific proposal before the example develops.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand the new idea and want to see how the book tests it.
sentenceIntentions.ttsDirection: Explain the proposed idea in a warm, ordinary voice; emphasize the concrete choice the listener can inspect, without announcing a proven breakthrough.

sentenceIntentions.text: The book proposes linking each claim to its data, assumptions, methods, and checks.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Explain the proposed approach in concrete terms.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Picture a claim with traceable data and checks behind it.

sentenceIntentions.text: An article would still explain the ideas and uncertainties that code alone cannot express.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Preserve the role of human explanation.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand why the proposal does not replace articles with programs.

sentenceIntentions.text: If a source changes, researchers could follow which conclusions need another look.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Offer a practical benefit to investigate.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Imagine locating the work affected by a changed source.

sentenceIntentions.text: The book also examines what happens when one AI chooses the evidence and judges its own work.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Question whether the same AI should choose and judge its evidence.

sentenceIntentions.text: Its proposals invite builders and researchers to test a more careful kind of automated help.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Keep the invitation honest about maturity.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect testable proposals rather than a finished scientific machine.

sentenceIntentions.text: Where is the missing link between repeating a result and understanding why it should be trusted?
sentenceIntentions.purpose: End with the book’s question in accessible language.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to follow the argument beyond merely reproducing an output.
